Head SP 0: the highest source in the head location (nothing worn); SP does not stack (Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 184)
Body SP 15: the highest source in the body location (Flak 15); SP does not stack (Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 184)
Armor Penalty -4: the most punishing penalty of the armour worn, taken once for both locations (Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 184; Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 350)

head armour penalty 0: the most punishing Armor Penalty worn in the head location (nothing worn); the sheet takes it once, as cpr.armor.penalty (Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 184, p. 350)
body armour penalty -4: the most punishing Armor Penalty worn in the body location (Flak -4); the sheet takes it once, as cpr.armor.penalty (Cyberpunk RED core rulebook p. 184, p. 350)
